writingEssays.essay: In recent years, artificial intelligence has substantially transformed modern education. Many educators believe that AI can personalize learning experiences, whereas others argue that it might diminish face-to-face communication. In my opinion, integrating digital tools under teacher supervision yields the most effective results.

speakingResponses.question: Describe an unforgettable journey you have taken.
speakingResponses.transcript: Well, to be honest, I really enjoyed visiting Samarkand last summer. The historic architecture and the Registan square took my breath away. It was truly an enriching cultural experience.

writingEssays.essay: Global warming represents one of the most critical challenges of our time. Governments must prioritize investing in solar and wind power to curb greenhouse gas emissions and safeguard future generations.

speakingResponses.question: Do you prefer working alone or in a team?
